tagline.en: Gamified travel eSIM for 200+ countries with rewards coins
tagline.zh: 游戏化旅行 eSIM，200+ 国家带奖励金币

description.en: Global YO sells travel eSIMs for 200+ countries with a gamified twist: YO coins/rewards, social-style app and frequent in-app deals. Prices on its homepage start around $2.19.
description.zh: Global YO 面向 200+ 国家销售旅行 eSIM，走游戏化路线：YO 金币奖励、社区风格 App 与高频应用内优惠。首页价格约 $2.19 起。

zh: 金币奖励与应用内优惠

details.en:
Global YO takes a "gamified + community" approach: YO coins and rewards, a social-style app and frequent in-app deals, covering 200+ countries and regions. Homepage rendered 2026-11-10: price tiles from $2.19 (also $2.89/$3.89/$4.89/$5.89 tiers).

The real pitch is a low-price-and-discounts ecosystem: coins offset costs, referrals pay out, and promotions run constantly. The trade-off is limited transparency - little disclosed corporate information, per-plan tables only in the app, and poorly maintained category deep-links (404 on the site).

Who it fits: budget-sensitive younger travellers willing to work the app for deals.

Notes: cheap packs are usually tiny; per-destination networks are not disclosed; and for critical trips do not stake your only connectivity on a promo tier - validate with a small purchase first.
details.zh:
Global YO 走「游戏化 + 社区」路线：YO 金币奖励、社交风格 App 与高频应用内优惠，覆盖 200+ 国家和地区。2026-11-10 渲染首页实核：价格卡 $2.19 起（另见 $2.89/$3.89/$4.89/$5.89 档）。

它的实际卖点是低价与折扣生态：金币可以抵扣、邀请有奖励、促销频繁；但对应代价是信息透明度一般——品牌主体披露有限、逐套餐表只在 App 内、分类深链（官网 404）维护不佳。

适合人群：预算敏感、愿意花时间在 App 里「薅羊毛」的年轻旅行者。

注意：低价包容量通常很小；落地网络未按目的地披露；重要行程不建议把唯一上网手段押在促销档上，先小额验证再加大用量。

补充：YO 金币体系与折扣档常随活动变化，本文价格仅为 2026-11-10 快照；下单前在 App 内以当日报价为准，并优先选择可热点的档位。

bestFor.en: Young travellers who like gamified rewards
bestFor.zh: 喜欢游戏化奖励的年轻旅行者

en: Gamification over substance - plan depth unclear
zh: 游戏化多于实质——套餐深度不明

plansNote.en: Homepage price tiles rendered 2026-11-10 ($2.19-$5.89); deep catalog pages 404 - full catalog lives in the app.
plansNote.zh: 2026-11-10 渲染首页价格卡（$2.19-5.89）；分类深链 404，完整目录在 App 内。

note.en: Network partners not disclosed per destination (2026-11-10).
note.zh: 未按目的地披露合作网络（2026-11-10）。
